name: lesser-boon-of-revelry-targeting-yourself-puts-a-buff-counter-on-your-only-ally
notes: Lesser Boon of Revelry (3): you are the target player. Pre-fix the cost was unpaid and the counter was never placed.

rulesClauses: (3): Target player that controls exactly one ally puts a buff counter on an ally they control without a buff counter on it.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Lesser Boon of Revelry: the generated handler ($myAllies/$theirAllies) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used. The (3) activation cost was also never paid: GAFieldAbilityCostTable() now charges it.
